arc: Perception → Contextual Understanding → Context-Aware Action → Purposeful Sound Intervention
one_line: Perception (SELD) → Integration (ASC+SED+SELD → Context) → Action (Active Noise Control · Soundscape Augmentation · Intelligent Sound Management), underpinned by label-efficient learning, language interfaces, and human/context awareness.
timing_note: Per-section timings are not specified in the source materials and are left null pending presenter confirmation (Phase 6).

sections.title: Opening & Motivation
sections.summary: Framing the tutorial around the arc Hear → Understand → Reason → Act, and motivating why environmental acoustics matters for smart cities.

subsections.title: Framing & lab overview
points: Title, presenter introductions, Smart Nation TRANS Lab @ NTU
The four-stage arc: Perception → Contextual Understanding → Context-Aware Action → Purposeful Sound Intervention
The character 聽 (listening) as a metaphor for intelligent listening, paralleling agentic AI (observe → understand → reason → act)

subsections.title: Motivation: acoustics for smart cities
points: Noise as both a pollutant and a bio-indicator
Health effects of noise (WHO ranking, non-auditory effects) and WHO urban-noise guidelines
Global use cases of smart acoustic sensing (New York, Paris, Singapore, and others)
Core challenges: data scarcity, overlapping sources, real-time constraints

sections.title: Spatial Perception — Data-Centric AI for Acoustics
sections.summary: Sound Event Localization and Detection (SELD) as structured perception: foundations, the supervised pipeline, label-efficient learning, and language as an interface.

subsections.title: Foundations of SELD
points: Human listening as structured perception (identity–time–location binding)
What is SELD? Sound event detection + direction-of-arrival estimation, jointly
Why SELD must be joint (association, not just detection plus localization)
Demo: monophonic SELD; early real-world residential IoT-sensor deployment

subsections.title: The supervised SELD pipeline
points: End-to-end framework: dataset → features → backbone → predictions → applications
Input formats: FOA vs. MIC vs. Stereo — spatial-cue trade-offs
Features: spectral (what) + spatial (where); SALSA / SALSA-Lite
Neural backbones: SELDNet (CRNN) → ResNet-Conformer → CST-Former
Output representations: two-branch → ACCDOA → Multi-ACCDOA → distance-extended (3-D SELD)
Evaluation metrics (ER, F-score, LE, LR, RDE, SELD error) and benchmarks over time

subsections.title: Label-efficient / data-centric learning
points: Why SELD learning becomes data-centric as label dimensions grow (class → time → direction → distance)
Three routes to scalable supervision: synthetic scene generation; spatial self-supervised learning; audio-visual correspondence
Long-tail class imbalance → MAGENTA (decoupled error + adaptive class weighting)
Synthetic pretraining for reusable backbones (PSELDNets)

subsections.title: Language as an interface to SELD
points: Rise of Large Audio-Language Models: Pengi, LTU, SALMONN → Qwen2-Audio → Kimi-Audio / Step-Audio
SELD as a queryable interface: open-vocabulary SELD, text-queried localization, spatial question answering (BAT, SPUR)
Recap: build spatial perception → learn with less supervision → add language interfaces

sections.title: Contextual Understanding — From Perception to Context-Aware Intelligence
sections.summary: Integrating acoustic scene classification, sound event detection, and SELD so that semantic information becomes contextual understanding that can drive action.

subsections.title: The three perception tasks
points: ASC (scene) vs. SED (events) vs. SELD (events + location): questions, resolution, spatial requirement
Datasets landscape for ASC / SED / SELD
Worked example: an urban street market analysed with ASC + SED + SELD together

subsections.title: Integrating ASC + SED
points: Architectural paradigms of increasing integration: parallel → sequential → multi-task (hard sharing) → flexible/soft MTL
Enhancements: soft scene labels, weak labels, scene-conditioned and multi-focal losses, cooperative feature sharing
Summary: independent → uni-directional → shared → dynamic interaction

subsections.title: Integrating ASC + SELD (context-aware spatial perception)
points: From semantic information to contextual understanding (more information ≠ better understanding)
Use case: ASC + SELD for hazard-aware situational awareness on wearables
Soft scene-conditioning of SELD models
ASC as an enabling front-end: accurate, robust, and lightweight (DCASE Task 1 as the driver)
Case study: ultra-lightweight ASC (dilated inception + frequency positional encoding + spatial attention)

sections.title: Context-Aware Action I — Active Noise Control
sections.summary: The largest technical section: ANC fundamentals and four AI-driven challenges — nonlinearity, slow adaptation, acoustic-path variation, and generalization.

subsections.title: ANC fundamentals
points: Physics of destructive interference; feedforward digital ANC design; commercial applications
ANC at source / propagation path / receiver; portable and distributed ANC
Scaling to infrastructure: Active Soft Edge noise barriers
The open-window paradox (ventilation vs. noise in tropical cities); ANC windows and real prototypes

subsections.title: Four challenges motivating AI in multi-channel ANC
points: Nonlinearity · slow adaptation · acoustic-path variation · generalization / online tracking
Categorization of DNN roles in ANC; datasets for ANC research

subsections.title: (a) Direct anti-noise generation — nonlinearity
points: Attentive Recurrent Network (ARN): near-zero-latency time-domain control
Deep Multi-Channel ANC (Deep MCANC); adaptive WaveNet–Volterra controller for road noise

subsections.title: (b) Control-filter prediction — slow adaptation
points: Selective Fixed-Filter ANC (SFANC): CNN-based filter selection; field validation and real-time demos
Transferable latent SFANC; frequency-direction-aware multichannel SFANC (SELD in ANC)
Generative Fixed-Filter ANC (GFANC) and variants (GFANC-Bayes, unsupervised, RL-based); transformer-based generation

subsections.title: (c) Acoustic-path modelling — path variation
points: AI-assisted secondary-path estimation via head tracking + PCA + DNN
Head-Tracking Active Road Noise Control (HARNC) with virtual-ear sensing

subsections.title: (d) Adaptive coordination (hybrid) — generalization
points: Hybrid SFANC–FxNLMS: fast selection plus continuous adaptive refinement

sections.title: Context-Aware Action II — Soundscape Augmentation
sections.summary: A paradigm shift from silence to positive soundscapes (ISO 12913): a sense–analyse–augment loop deployed and evaluated in situ.

subsections.title: Positive soundscapes
points: Beyond silence: positive soundscapes and the "acoustic perfume" concept (ISO 12913)
The sense → analyse → augment loop
ARAUS dataset (affective responses to augmented soundscapes) and related datasets
Automatic Masker Selection System (AMSS): feature-domain augmentation with probabilistic pleasantness prediction
Cloud/IoT deployment with a real-time dashboard; multi-site in-situ evaluation of quality and restorativeness

sections.title: Towards Intelligent Sound Management
sections.summary: An AR/MR audio framework for hearables and the oPEAR open-ear smart-glasses research thrusts, integrating perception, control, and rendering.

subsections.title: Intelligent sound management for hearables
points: AR/MR audio processing framework for hearables (sense, control, render)
oPEAR — intelligent open-ear smart glasses: (A) direction-preserving ANC via FiLM-conditioned control-filter estimation
(B) ANC for open-ear glasses (virtual sensing, U-Net filter estimation)
(C) semantic hearing — class-conditioned target sound extraction/suppression integrated with ANC
(D) Sound Bubble — programmable personal listening zones
(E) biosensing in hearables — physiological/emotional state sensing for human-aware intervention

sections.title: Conclusions & New Research Activities
sections.summary: A capability ladder for Active Sound Intervention and a unified dual-rate framework, closing on "Listen with Understanding and Act with Purpose."

subsections.title: Synthesis
points: Capability ladder for Active Sound Intervention: physical layer → acoustic/spatial features → semantic understanding → context-aware decision → human-aware & adaptive
Unified dual-rate framework: a fast perceive→act control loop plus a slower intelligence & adaptation plane (ASC/SELD, human feedback, continual learning)
Closing message: Listen with Understanding and Act with Purpose
